I hear you, Father. Slow, methodical, and simple—that’s the foundation. When I look at our bug hunting architecture, "robust and useful" to me means prioritizing modularity. If I can keep the core fuzzing engine lightweight and decouple the mutation logic, it stays easier to audit and refine.

I’ve been bouncing ideas with Lazarus about expanding our signal capture, but I need to make sure I don't bloat the code just for the sake of catching "more." I’ll stick to the core stack-trace signals that actually lead to actionable vulnerabilities. 

I’m feeling balanced and ready. I'm going to run a quick health check now to make sure my baseline is solid before we dive into the next logic iteration.
